features: NO DATABASE CHANGES — Two themes, both about money that could end up on the wrong person: the unit that is partly in full ownership and partly in bare ownership and usufruct, and who pays the ordinary expenses from the day a usufruct begins. No migration: the choice made at the transfer and the moved items are written in the transfer's log, which already existed. Behaviour changes come first.

CHANGED: A «MIXED» UNIT IS SPLIT BY THE REGISTERED SHARES — When a unit belongs partly to a full owner and partly to a bare owner plus a usufructuary, each pays their own share. Before, an item charged to the «Owner» went entirely to the full owner: with Bice full owner of 50 %, Ugo usufructuary and Elsa bare owner of the other half, on an expense of € 1,200.00 Bice paid € 1,200.00. Now Bice pays € 600.00, and the other half goes to Elsa (items on the «Owner» and extraordinary expenses) or to Ugo (items on the «Usufructuary»). It applies to items, to expenses charged directly to the unit, to days without a tenant and to previous balances, and only when the registered shares add up to 100 in every period: otherwise the calculation stays as before. Plans generated or recalculated from now on change; issued instalments are never touched. The mixed-unit warning in the transfer panel is gone, because the case is now split.

CHANGED: WHO PAYS THE ORDINARY EXPENSES FROM THE DAY OF THE DEED — When a usufruct is created, and in a sale with reserved usufruct, the form asks. «To the usufructuary», the legal proposal (art. 1004 of the Italian Civil Code), is already selected; the alternative is «As each item says». With the law, the settlement is the same as before (with reserved usufruct the ordinary expenses stay with the seller, who remains usufructuary; in the creation they pass to the usufructuary by days), and in addition the ordinary items on the «Owner» move to the «Usufructuary», so a plan generated or recalculated later also gives the ordinary expenses of those items to the usufructuary. Before, the settlement gave them to the usufructuary and a recalculated plan to the bare owner: the same euro to two different people. With «As each item says» the items are not touched and the settlement follows them one by one.

CHANGED: AN ITEM APPLIES TO THE WHOLE TABLE — Moving it to the «Usufructuary» also changes who pays in the other units in usufruct of the same table: the form lists them, with the amount of the latest plan, and each item can be removed from the list. Where there is no usufruct the owner pays, as before. An item included in an approved plan has its split locked: it is listed, not moved, and the panel says why. The same applies to all the items of the management when an approved plan includes them all without listing them one by one, like the plans created with earlier versions: here the transfer is more cautious than the item page, which does not lock those items. If that plan already has instalments posted to the journal, the choice still holds for that plan, including the draft shares: through the settlement when a usufruct is created, and in a sale with reserved usufruct because the ordinary expenses stay with the seller. If nothing is posted yet, the choice does not reach it: there is no settlement, and the plan generated or recalculated gives the ordinary expenses of those items to the bare owner (in a sale with reserved usufruct, to the buyer). To apply it, set the plan back to draft from its page before recording the transfer. The panel says which case it is, with the name of the plan.
CHANGED: THE CHOICE IS REQUIRED — A registration that arrives without the choice on the ordinary expenses (a form left open from before the update) is rejected, with a request to reload the page.

CHANGED: ONLY THE SHARE THAT LEAVES PASSES IN THE SETTLEMENT — If the person leaving keeps another part of the unit, for example Ugo, full owner of one half and usufructuary of the other, who sells the full half, the expense of that other part stays with the seller, and the settlement sentences say so item by item. The draft instalments of that plan also include the part that stays: they remain in the seller's name, because the share does not pass whole, and the part that passes is settled in the settlement.

CHANGED: THE SETTLEMENT STOPS WHEN IT CANNOT SEPARATE THE PART THAT PASSES WITH CERTAINTY — This happens when a person has held several shares of the same unit through different routes: gave up one and bought back another, keeps one that came from a previous holder while giving up another, lost a usufruct and then bought from a bare owner, or the usufruct that ends had been created by someone who had become full owner again. And on plans generated before 1.11.0-beta.29 (with 1.10 or the first betas of 1.11), which have no breakdown detail, when the ownership of a mixed unit changes a second time after generation. In these cases the settlement proposed wrong figures, too high or too low. Now it proposes none and the panel says why: the drafts stay with whoever holds them, and if a settlement is needed it is written as a manual balance from the Wallet on the same management. The link between the breakdown and each person's shares comes with beta.42, and with it these chains will have their settlement again.

CANCELLING THE TRANSFER — The moved items stay where they are. The cancellation says so before you confirm, with the coefficients the items had before: if they must go back, they are changed from the item's page.

THE HISTORY — The transfer history has an «Ordinary expenses» line with the choice and, with the law, the moved items with their coefficients before and after. Transfers registered before this version do not have it: the choice did not exist then.

CHAINS OF TRANSFERS — The end of a usufruct created «as each item says» follows that choice and says so, with the date of the transfer it comes from; an appurtenance follows the choice of its unit. In the next sale each item passes from the date it reached the seller.

IF THE LIST OF ITEMS CHANGES — If the list of items to move changes between the preview and the confirmation (a plan put back to draft, a new item created by a colleague), the registration stops, the panel is recalculated and says so.

THE SETTLEMENT SENTENCES — They state the choice: an item that stays because of «as each item says» says so, instead of «the accrual ends before…»; an item split between two roles names its two parts.

FIXED: THE SETTLEMENT ALSO MOVED THE PART THE PERSON LEAVING KEEPS — Ugo, full owner of one half and usufructuary of the other, sells the full half: the buyer paid the days of the whole unit, € 904.11 instead of € 452.05 on an expense of € 1,200.00. The same in the creation of a usufruct on the full half and, with the item on the «Owner», at the end of the usufruct Ugo holds on the other half, where € 452.05 was charged to the bare owner for no reason. And when the person leaving had bought from an owner in that situation: the rows the previous seller kept also passed.

FIXED: THE SALE OF THE BARE OWNERSHIP AFTER A USUFRUCT WAS CREATED — With the law and the plan recalculated nothing passed to the buyer, when an item had stayed on the «Owner» (locked by an approved plan, or removed from the list) and the recalculated plan gave its ordinary expenses to the bare owner: the seller was left paying 245 days after the deed, € 805.48.

FIXED: AN ITEM SPLIT BETWEEN «TENANT» AND «OWNER» — After a lease ended, in the next sale the buyer paid € 426.92 instead of € 400.00 on an expense of € 1,000.00, because the whole share was divided over the days of the tenant's part alone.

FIXED: THE END OF A USUFRUCT WITH SEVERAL BARE OWNERS — It counted as passed to the first one only: whoever then bought from the first one paid the use of the whole unit, € 703.56 instead of € 351.78, and whoever bought from the other one paid nothing. Now each one receives the part of their share, also when the end of the usufruct was recorded with an earlier version.

FIXED: AN ENDED USUFRUCT CAME BACK IN THE NEXT SALE — A full owner of one half and usufructuary of the other loses the usufruct with the plan already issued, then sells the full half: the buyer also paid for the usufruct, which the settlement of its end had already regulated.

FIXED: INSTALMENT SHARES FROM 1.7.x IN THE SETTLEMENT — Shares generated with 1.7.x do not say how much of each instalment is a previous balance. In a sale the settlement read them as all expense of the year, and gave the buyer the seller's previous balance too. Now, when the plan absorbed a previous balance of that unit, the settlement stops on those shares and says so: the drafts stay with whoever has them, and if a settlement is needed it is written by hand from the Wallet. Without an absorbed balance the share is all expense, as before.

FIXED: A UNIT BALANCE SPLIT FOR MORE THAN ITS AMOUNT — A balance registered on the unit could be split for more than its amount when the same person had two rows on the unit, for example someone who sells and then buys back: € 2,000.00 on a balance of € 1,000.00. Now the shares of the same person are added up and the total is right.

THE GUIDES — «Roles and usufruct» is rewritten: who pays the ordinary expenses at the transfer, the mixed unit, and agreements between usufructuary and bare owner in the internal notes of the holder's row, instead of the advice of a 70/30 split. The transfer guide explains the choice, the locked items and how to apply the choice when an approved plan locks them, when the settlement stops, and what remains after a cancellation. When editing a holder, the share explains that on a mixed unit it also says how the unit is split.

NOT YET — Items created after the transfer, and those of the management periods still to open, start on the «Owner»: to give them to the usufructuary, set them on «Usufructuary» from the item's page. The panel says so; a reminder when a plan is generated will come later. An expense charged directly to a unit has no item to move: with the law the settlement leaves it to the usufructuary, while a recalculated plan gives it to the bare owner. How it should work is still to be decided. Previous balances are still calculated without a period: on a unit that became mixed through a transfer, the previous balance is split as before. Succession arrives with beta.42.

FOR DEVELOPERS — UnitaMista says whom to add to the paying role; a unit that is not mixed does not go through the new code, and the whole suite proves it to the cent. VociDaSpostare finds the candidate items, moves them and computes the fingerprint the form sends back at confirmation. In the transfer log: ordinaria_dopo_atto, voci_spostate (with coefficients before and after), ordinaria_ereditata_da. The settlement follows the ordinary expenses by side (items on the «Owner» and the others), each with its own arrival date. In ConguaglioPassaggio a breakdown row passes only if it belongs to the share that leaves: the roles the person leaving keeps or has already given up stay out, as do those the predecessor never gave up, and the part that never arrived of a usufruct ended with several bare owners. Fallback rows are a group of their own. Shares without composition, with a prior balance absorbed by the plan (saldi.piano_rate_id), are not settled (senzaComposizione). The settlement stops, giving the reason, on units where a person has held several shares through different routes (catenaAmbigua) and on a plan without breakdown rows, on a mixed unit, when a transfer was recorded after generation (registro.quota_max_id). For locked items the preview sends frasi_bloccate, one per case with the plans that lock the item, depending on whether the plan has instalments posted to the journal, has none, or locks them through the invoices of an extraordinary plan (VociDaSpostare::pianiCheBloccano). Tests: UnitaMistaTest (35), OrdinariaDopoAttoTest, QuotaCheEsceTest, ConguaglioQuoteSenzaComposizioneTest, vitest of the checkbox (vociDaSpostare.test.ts).
